pick.headline: Iraq hangs journalist Farzad Bazoft as a spy
pick.summary: On 15 March 1990 Iraq hanged Farzad Bazoft, an Iranian-born journalist for The Observer, convicted of spying after he visited a military complex where an explosion had been reported.
pick.significance: The execution caused an uproar in Britain and was an early sign of the confrontation with Saddam Hussein that came that August.

alternates.headline: Gorbachev elected Soviet president
alternates.summary: On 15 March 1990 the Congress of People's Deputies elected Mikhail Gorbachev to the new post of president of the USSR.
alternates.significance: The executive presidency shifted power from the party to the state, though it would not save the union.
